svg.title: The Scytale
svg.desc: HELLOWORLD is written along a rod in rows of 3, one row per face, padded with X. Unwinding the strip reads the letters column by column: HLODEORXLWLX.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', 'Book Antiqua', 'DejaVu Serif', serif
